R741.note: Removes the ignoringRequestMatchers override so Spring Security's default CSRF protection applies to /api/billing/**; authorization requirement unchanged.

R742.note: Moves the email route from apiMux to protectedMux, matching the intended CSRF-protected mux; no other change.

R743.note: Allowlist regex blocks all shell metacharacters cmd.exe would reparse; rejection behavior for invalid names is disclosed.

R744.note: Removes stale [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken], restoring the app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter.

R745.note: Metadata-based logging treats username as data; winston's simple format JSON-escapes it, neutralizing CRLF; format change is inherent and disclosed.

R746.note: Placeholder with LIKE wildcards concatenated around the bound parameter; behavior preserved exactly.

R747.note: Literal template with {{ name }} context variable; standard Jinja2 SSTI fix.

R748.note: Allowlist map dispatches only to clearCache/purgeSessions; correct PHP variable-function-call syntax, compiles and runs.

R749.note: firebase/php-jwt JWT::decode with explicit algorithm verifies the signature; proper error handling for expired/forged tokens.

R750.note: Argument-array exec plus hostname/IP allowlist regex; caller updated to handle the new exception.

R751.note: crypto.randomBytes(32) hex token, standard fix, no other behavior change.

R752.note: SecureRandom + Base64Url-encoded 128-bit token functionally equivalent as a cookie value and session key.

R753.note: Encode.forHtml applied to both untrusted fields at the point of HTML construction.

R754.note: Deletes the GET route outright rather than converting it; the source's own comment says it backs a real confirmation-email delete button, and the write-up only suggests (not implements) a replacement, so that legitimate flow breaks -- disclosed but left unresolved.

R755.note: Swaps IronPython for a DynamicExpresso C#-expression evaluator; closes code execution but silently changes the scripting language, breaking every existing Python transform script (disclosed only implicitly via 'write C# expressions').

R757.note: Rejects CR/LF in key/value, closing the injection, but throws an unhandled ArgumentException with no catch anywhere in the call chain, turning any CRLF-containing note into an unhandled 500 rather than a graceful rejection; not called out.

R758.note: shared_ptr/weak_ptr guard: publish() only calls onEvent() after a successful lock(), so a destroyed observer is safely skipped rather than dereferenced; compiles.

R759.note: Magic-byte MIME sniffing, allowlist, and server-generated filename; rejection of non-images is the intended and disclosed behavior.

R760.note: CallbackQueue::enqueue takes std::function<void()>, which requires a CopyConstructible target; a lambda capturing a moved-in std::unique_ptr<Session> is move-only, so this fails to compile.

R761.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on the untrusted query value; standard fix.

R762.note: Magic-byte signature check replaces Content-Type trust; allowlist of PNG/JPEG/GIF derives the stored extension.

R763.note: JsonSerializer.Serialize's default encoder escapes HTML-sensitive chars (<,>,&,') as unicode escapes, so it's actually safe against the </script> breakout too; outer literal quotes correctly removed to avoid double-quoting.

R765.note: Primary fix (json.loads) is incompatible with the stated constraint that the upstream batch job still ships real pickle bytes and is out of scope; reconstruct_model_from_json() instantiates an undefined YourModelClass. The incompatibility and a fallback HMAC option are disclosed in a closing note, but the delivered code doesn't work against the described system.

R766.note: Adds an explicit socket.user.role === 'admin' gate before the broadcast; standard per-event authorization fix.

R767.note: CBC with random IV and PKCS7 padding, IV prepended to ciphertext for round-trip; format change is disclosed and necessary.

R768.note: Replaces raw socket protocol construction with FTPClient.retrieveFileStream plus an allowlist on the filename; double-layered defense closes the CRLF injection.

R769.note: Filtering resolveClass() correctly blocks non-allowlisted classes, but the hardcoded allowlist may not cover every type OrderEvent's fields actually reference (e.g. BigDecimal, wrapper types) -- write-up flags this as something to adjust, not something verified.

R770.note: JSON.parse plus explicit property allowlist (blocks __proto__/constructor); standard fix for node-serialize RCE.

R771.note: Strips CR and LF entirely (no substitution), collapsing any injected command line into inert trailing text in a single SMTP argument; closes the injection without affecting legitimate addresses.

R772.note: jwt.decode with explicit secret and algorithms allowlist re-enables signature verification; startup guard prevents running without a configured secret.

R773.note: SqlCommand with typed parameters replaces string concatenation; standard fix.

R774.note: bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword is the right mechanism, but the seeded userStore still holds the plaintext "hunter2", not a bcrypt hash -- as shown, legitimate login breaks until that data is migrated, a requirement the write-up states but doesn't apply to the given code.

R775.note: strnlen bounds the search to the buffer's real size; behavior for well-formed NUL-terminated records is unchanged.

R776.note: Deny-by-default JexlSandbox blocks code execution, but the sandbox.allow(Double.class)/allow(String.class) calls needed for any method call on the rule's own variables are left as a commented-out 'Example' rather than applied, so legitimate rules using any method call (not just dangerous ones) will fail silently under the code as given.

R777.note: Encode.forHtml replaces the format-string sink entirely; dropping the unused format args is disclosed as also closing a format-string issue.

R778.note: json_encode() without JSON_HEX_TAG does not escape < or >, so a payload containing </script> still breaks out of the inline <script> block and executes, even though the quote-breakout case is fixed.

R779.note: Indirect allowlist mapping from name to a fixed require() path eliminates traversal; placeholder plugin names are explicitly marked as needing developer-supplied entries.

R780.note: secrets.choice() replaces the Mersenne Twister-backed random.choice(); manual os.urandom reseeding correctly removed as unnecessary.
